title: colophon: a conformance and provenance census of AI-derived DICOM objects in the NCI Imaging Data Commons

creators.name: Patil, Digvijay
creators.affiliation: University at Buffalo School of Management, Buffalo, NY, USA

description: Measurement code, claims ledger, generated tables and figure builders for a conformance and provenance census of the derived, non-image SOP classes of NCI Imaging Data Commons release v24. The archive itself is not redistributed here: every fetched object was deleted after validation, and the per-object records the census derives are excluded because part of the source archive is CC BY-NC. See RELEASE_NOTES for what the snapshot contains and why.
notes: The version DOI, not the concept DOI, is the one cited in the accompanying manuscript.
